species.real: Hereward was only called 'the Wake' long after his death, possibly meaning watchful, and Charles Kingsley's 1866 novel turned him into a Victorian hero.
species.name: Hereward

dex.text: Rises out of the reeds whenever the Isle is threatened, mud to the knees and grinning under his helmet. Has never once been caught. Doesn't intend to start.
dex.fact: Hereward the Wake led the English holding the Isle of Ely against William the Conqueror in 1070 and 1071. When the Isle fell he escaped, and nobody knows what became of him.
